text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When you find a bug, the first step is to identify the problem clearly. Try to reproduce the error and understand when and why it happens. Next, use debugging tools such as breakpoints or step-by-step execution to see what your code is really doing. A systematic approach helps a lot: check your code one section at a time instead of guessing. Logging is also very useful, because log messages show what happened before the error appeared. With patience and good habits, you can solve most bugs quickly and become a more confident developer.
